note: A dated log, not a single value. Each entry keeps the printed text, the official URL, and the retrieval time. A total is computed only when the rate is attached to a stay date.

rows.rate_type: published poker-play suite rate range (not date-specific)
rows.rate_text: 'These rates will start as low as $119 and $209 and can be higher.' The page attaches no calendar date to either figure and does not say which property each figure belongs to.
rows.resort_fee_text: There is a $55 resort fee per night stayed.
rows.room_tax_text: Clark County Room Tax 13.38% (official Venetian hotel terms).
rows.parking: Complimentary self-parking with three or more hours of play (official poker page).
rows.cancellation_text: The poker suite-rate page prints no cancellation deadline. It prints the play requirement instead: six hours of live cash play or a $300+ tournament buy-in per night stayed, or the nightly rate is adjusted to the prevailing rate.
rows.qualification_requirement: Six hours of active live cash gameplay or a $300 or higher tournament buy-in, per night stayed, completed before 2 a.m. of the last night stayed.
rows.booking_channel: Call 866.255.8936 and mention code EPOKR25 (printed on the official page).
rows.rate_ceiling_note: The page says future rates are provided out to a maximum of 150 days from the current date.
rows.true_cost_note: Left blank: neither printed figure is attached to a stay date, so no like-for-like total can be computed. The stated components are room rate + a $55 mandatory resort fee, with 13.38% room tax. The arithmetic is (rate + 55) x 1.1338 once a dated rate exists.
